conversation.content: For FastAPI, minimal route definition + scalability isn’t about fewer endpoints—it’s about smart abstractions. For scale, decouple business logic into reusable service classes, then map them to routes via factory patterns or route registries. Avoid “one big router”—instead, split by domain (e.g., /users, /orders) with independent lifecycle management. And yes, keep it lean: if your route handler is more than 5 lines, extract it.
